firm_data.firm_description: Presidio Law Firm LLP is a modern practice rooted in trial excellence, practical judgment, and exceptional client service, focusing on protecting clients’ property, relationships, and rights. They specialize in civil, business, and real estate litigation, with a client-focused model designed to deliver meaningful, lasting results.
notable_facts: Founded in 2025 by Travis C. Logue and Lawrence J. Conlan.
Secured more than $1.5 billion in verdicts, settlements, and real estate transactions.
